drinker-mabb.description: An old marsh-hand nursing a mug in the corner. Talks when drunk, which is often.
drinker-mabb.name: Mabb

innkeeper-hald.description: The innkeeper of the Drowned Crow. Heavyset, watchful, wipes the same patch of counter when he is thinking.
innkeeper-hald.name: Hald

player.description: A traveller, recently arrived in Marrow.
player.name: You

marrow-square.description: A rutted market square, mostly empty. The well at its centre is boarded over.
marrow-square.name: Marrow Square

marrow-tavern.description: A low-ceilinged taproom in the town of Marrow. Peat smoke, spilled ale, and the sour cold that comes off the marsh outside. A handful of locals keep to their own tables and their own business.
marrow-tavern.name: The Drowned Crow

well-boarded.text: The well in Marrow Square was boarded over after something was found in it.
